text:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT alert triggered - high tail latency for /v1/generate (eu-west-1) · 5xx spike detected · paging SRE Oncall now
Maria: saw the page, joining. getting current scope from logs
Ajay: i'm on network/egress checks, but early signs point to KV cache churn on the redis cluster servicing eu-west-1
Sam: confirming - increased eviction rate from 02:12:03UTC, correlates with burst of long-context requests, KV miss ratio up to 78%
Leo: which alert fired? is this the kv-cache-eviction alert or downstream 5xx?
Maria: both. incident-bot first flagged inference-5xx-rate-eu then kv-cache-eviction-eu popped 30s later
Caroline: customer reports: a batch of requests to the chat endpoint got 504s. CS says a paid customer in EU saw failures for ~3m
Nora: ok we need quick mitigations: 1) reduce TTL pressure, 2) fallback to small-cache-path, 3) scale dedicated pool. who can patch the routing fast?
Ajay: I can flip routing to bypass the shared cache and force local LRU for eu-west-1. doing a staged rollout to 10% now
Deploy Bot: deploy started: route-bypass-eu-west-1 @ajay (deploy id dpl-8932)
Maria: adding runbook link to thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction -- use the "emergency bypass" steps under 'Mitigation'
Sam: metric checkpoint: after 10% rollout latency p95 dropped from 420ms -> 280ms; 5xx rate down 40% at 02:18UTC
Leo: Can we also raise the alert threshold temporarily to avoid pager storms while we stabilize? current threshold is 10 rps 5xx for 5m
Nora: yes propose: increase window to 10m and threshold to 20 rps for eu-west only. We'll annotate the alert and revert after stabilizing
Caroline: I'll coordinate messaging to CS: short note that we mitigated an infra issue and are monitoring. no PII exposed.
Ajay: deploy dpl-8932 at 10% -> 50% -> 100% complete. full rollout done 02:26UTC.
Maria: great work. action items post-incident: 1) add dashboard panels for kv miss ratio by model shard, 2) add runbook step to automatically check eviction rate, 3) add owner to alert (ops@redwood)
Sam: I'll create the dashboard tile: Grafana panel 'KV miss ratio (eu-west-1) by shard' and link in the runbook. PR incoming: https://git.redwood/ops/grafana/pulls/412
Leo: I'll open an alert-tuning PR to change the eu-west 5xx alert to include a suppression during planned cache-rollovers and add a runbook link in the alert definition. PR: https://git.redwood/infra-alerts/pulls/789
Nora: ownership: can SRE Oncall take alert owner for 2 weeks while we iterate on auto-heal?
SRE Oncall: yes, will rotate ownership and monitor daily. I'll add calendar reminders.
Maria: also need to add an annotated timeline to the incident page: start, mitigation steps, deploy ids, dashboards, customer impact note. I'll draft the summary and ping for approvals
Caroline: CS note drafted, sending to impacted customers now. will include a short timeline and ask if they saw lingering issues
Incident Bot: INCIDENT update: severity reduced to SEV2 · monitoring for next 48m · follow-up runbook edits required
Maria: follow-ups tracked: - grafana PR (Sam) - alert PR (Leo) - runbook edit with explicit 'bypass routing' and 'revert thresholds' steps (Maria) - postmortem draft (Caroline)
Ajay: leaving notes in infra ticket with checks I ran: `redis info`, `latency histogram`, `eviction_rate` snapshot. ticket: https://issues.redwood/IR-4021
Sam: PR https://git.redwood/ops/grafana/pulls/412 created with panel + example query and link back to runbook
Maria: i'll own the runbook update. target: include annotated screenshots, exact CLI commands we used, and a checklist to patch back to normal thresholds. PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pulls/134
Leo: once PRs land, let's schedule a brief playbook review in next oncall handoff to ensure new steps are clear
SRE Oncall: acknowledged. i'll add to the morning handoff doc and mark alert as 'under-study' until we've automated suppression
Caroline: thanks all, excellent fast mitigation. keeping this thread as canonical for the incident artifacts.
Maria: closing the live mitigation channel. postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT resolved (mitigated) · final status: degraded->stable · end time 02:46UTC
Maria: thread closed, moving follow-ups to async tickets and PR reviews.
